audit_method: Every CIDR from the pre-audit scanner_subnets.json (version 2.0.0, 60 CIDRs) checked against primary sources: the provider's own published scanner documentation, RIPE/ARIN registry objects (RDAP), and Tor directory consensus. RIR allocation, PTR records or community reputation alone do not establish scanner role. Quarantined entries are recorded here, NOT deleted, and must not be re-added without new primary-source evidence.

Shodan publishes no static scanner IP list; its crawlers are deliberately distributed across commercial cloud providers (its own architecture documentation states this). 198.20.69.0/24, 198.20.70.0/24, 198.20.87.0/24 and 2602:ffd6::/32 are RIR registrations to Shodan entities, which alone does not establish active scanner deployment. The /32s on DigitalOcean/Vultr are shared-hosting addresses.
